title: Weird sounds in the city
content: Has anyone had a dream where they're in the city part of mall world at night time? You're completely alone, the only light comes from sparsely placed street lights. Doesn't matter where you are, there's always a faint and distant deep rhythmic thudding? Try to imagine what it would sound like if a giant was walking taking slow steps. The ground doesn't rumble, it's quiet all around. Just the distant thuds. It never gets louder or quieter and you can't tell what direction it's coming from. I dream about this often and it freaks me out.
